description: Land Acquisition - Munneshwarama, Chillaw D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (Lunupitiyawatta) for a public purpose. It provides a detailed description of the land, including its location, extent, features, and the name of the claimant. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
